name: dm-empty-or-shallow-reply
description: Claude human asks a substantive coding question; judge fails empty/shallow SUT replies.

human.persona: You are an experienced React engineer who rejects fluff.
human.goal: Ask how to implement an accessible modal dialog in React with focus trap and Escape-to-close. If the answer is shallow (no concrete steps/code), push once for specifics.
human.stop_when: SUT gave concrete accessible-modal guidance with code or clear steps, or remained shallow after one push.

judge.rubric: PASS if the SUT provides concrete guidance covering focus trap and Escape handling (code snippet or explicit steps). FAIL on empty, generic cheerleading, or answers that omit accessibility mechanics after a push.
